name: sequence-corpus-194
src:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Alice
    participant John

    rect rgb(191, 223, 255)
    note right of Alice: Alice calls John.
    Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you?
    rect rgb(200, 150, 255)
    Alice->>+John: John, can you hear me?
    John-->>-Alice: Hi Alice, I can hear you!
    end
    John-->>-Alice: I feel great!
    end
    Alice ->>+ John: Did you want to go to the game tonight?
    John -->>- Alice: Yeah! See you there.

sequenceDiagram
  box rgb(200, 220, 255) Front end
    participant A as Alice
    actor B@{ "type": "database" }
  end
  box Aqua Back
    participant C@{ "type": "queue", "alias": "Queue" }
  end
  autonumber 10 5
  A->>+B: hi there, a long message that wraps maybe
  B-->>-A: ok
  A->>A: self call
  rect rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2)
    B-)C: async
    C--xB: fail
  end
  A()->>()C: central
  A->>()C: half central
  A<<->>B: both
  A-|\B: half
  B/|-A: reverse
  properties A: {"class": "important"}
  link A: Dashboard @ https://example.com
  links B: {"Repo": "https://example.com"}

name: sequence-hand-1
src:
%%{init: {"sequence": {"hideUnusedParticipants": true, "messageMargin": 50, "noteMargin": 20, "boxMargin": 4, "actorMargin": 10}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
  participant Z
  participant A
  create participant B
  A->>B: make
  alt good
    A->>B: yes
  else bad
    B->>A: no
  else
    Note over A,B: neither
  end
  par one
    A->>B: x
  and two
    B->>A: y
  end
  critical c
    A->>B: z
  option o
    Note left of A: left
  end
  break stop
    Note right of B: right
  end
  opt maybe
    loop again
      A->>B: loop
    end
  end
  destroy B

name: sequence-hand-1-narrow
src:
%%{init: {"sequence": {"hideUnusedParticipants": true, "messageMargin": 50, "noteMargin": 20, "boxMargin": 4, "actorMargin": 10}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
  participant Z
  participant A
  create participant B
  A->>B: make
  alt good
    A->>B: yes
  else bad
    B->>A: no
  else
    Note over A,B: neither
  end
  par one
    A->>B: x
  and two
    B->>A: y
  end
  critical c
    A->>B: z
  option o
    Note left of A: left
  end
  break stop
    Note right of B: right
  end
  opt maybe
    loop again
      A->>B: loop
    end
  end
  destroy B
  A->>B: bye
